The X.Org video driver for VIA based cards

xf86-video-trident provides the X.Org video driver for VIA/S3 CLE266,
KM400/KN400/K8M800 UniChrome based video cards which are frequently found in
low form-factor VIA motherboards, and in some laptops.
Flat panel, TV and VGA outputs are supported.
K8M800/K8N800, PM8X0 and CN400 support is still under development.
Direct rendering 3D is available using experimental drivers in Mesa.
Also there is an XvMC client library for hardware MPEG1/MPEG2 decoding
acceleration available on the CLE266 and K8M/N800 chipsets that uses the DRI.
The XvMC client library implements a nonstandard '34'VLD'34' extension to the
XvMC standard.
